trigger: One cast of Magic Missile produces rank plus two darts
cost: One selected spell slot; choices for individual darts are free
choices: Choose each visible creature or direct all remaining darts at one visible creature. Resolve all brackets of damage together, including double KO when aimed at both sides.

trigger: Named target of a dart can cast Shield if it can react and supply components
cost: One reaction, any legal slot; existing Shield already protects
choices: Select rank or pass after all darts assigned, before damage. Blocking darts aimed at that defender does not protect a different target.

trigger: Each beam has its own ranged spell attack
cost: One action; level 5 provides two beams
choices: Select same or different creatures or objects; Agonizing Blast applies on a learned cantrip from level 2.

trigger: Two or more identical base damage d8s on a hit
cost: Rolls per attack; up to slot rank leaps
choices: Select a fresh target within 30 feet of preceding target. Duplicate faces are read from the damage roll used to resolve the actual hit.

rule_source: SRD 5.2 pp. 14, 106 Unseen Attackers and Targets, clear path
trigger: Target not located and spell does not require sight
cost: Commit a projectile even when location is empty
choices: Choose row, column and elevation. Magic Missile requires sight; Eldritch Blast, Chromatic Orb and Scorching Ray can guess.
